name: Kerala Backwaters Tour
summary: Six days across Kerala's three signatures — tea-cool Munnar, boat-safari Thekkady and the Alleppey backwaters — ending with a private overnight houseboat and an Ayurvedic couples session. Built for couples who want the romance without the rush: two nights in the hills, unhurried drives, and dinners that come to you.
highlights: Private overnight kettuvallam houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters
Two nights amid Munnar's tea plantations
Periyar Lake boat safari and a spice garden walk
Kathakali evening and Fort Kochi heritage stroll

itinerary.title: Arrive Kochi
itinerary.description: Airport pickup, Fort Kochi walk past the Chinese fishing nets and St. Francis Church, evening Kathakali performance with the pre-show make-up ritual.

itinerary.title: Climb to Munnar
itinerary.description: Scenic drive into the Western Ghats with waterfall stops, first walk through the tea contours at golden hour.

itinerary.title: Munnar tea country
itinerary.description: Eravikulam National Park (home of the Nilgiri tahr), tea museum tasting, and a plantation-view dinner.

itinerary.title: Thekkady & Periyar
itinerary.description: Drive through cardamom country, afternoon boat safari on Periyar Lake, spice garden tour before dusk.

itinerary.title: Houseboat on the backwaters
itinerary.description: Board a private houseboat at Alleppey by noon — cruise the canals, freshly cooked Kerala meals onboard, sunset on deck, overnight at anchor.

itinerary.title: Disembark & depart
itinerary.description: Backwater sunrise, disembark after breakfast, transfer to Kochi for departure.
